hero.title: Prove the authority boundary locally before connecting hardware.
hero.summary: One fixed public revision. Three deterministic cases. No Vision Edge or MITHRIL integration until the public reproduction passes 3/3.

situation.title: The agreed first step
body: The first technical step stays entirely inside public, non-sensitive material. The physical bench is deliberately out of scope until the authority behavior is reproduced locally.
The synthetic path is: person_detected → authority request → consequence-time check → ALLOW/DENY → local execution logger.
REQVARIS will run the cases locally against one fixed public HEIMEL revision. Only after 3/3 local reproduction should the same Gateway boundary be connected to the local MITHRIL MQTT adapter.

theses.title: Fresh authority decides consequence
theses.body: The decisive check belongs immediately before the consequential action, not at detection time or at an earlier approval step.

theses.title: Revocation must remain effective
theses.body: Authority that disappears before the consequence-time check must produce DENY even if it was valid when the event was first observed.

theses.title: Hardware comes after semantics
theses.body: Vision Edge and MITHRIL add value only after the authority contract is independently reproduced without either system in the loop.

evidence.title: Case 1 — valid authority
evidence.body: Valid authority → ALLOW → execution request logged.

evidence.title: Case 2 — revoked/no authority
evidence.body: Revoked/no authority → DENY → no execution request.

evidence.title: Case 3 — stale earlier authority
evidence.body: Authority valid at detection, revoked before consequence-time check → DENY → no execution request.

proposal.title: Reproduction package status: pending export gate
body: VALO will name one fixed public HEIMEL revision only after the public export gate permits that revision to be exposed safely.

The reproduction package will then contain the exact revision, minimum public components, dependencies, start command, authority issue/revoke flow, request/response contract, Gateway path, evidence path and expected outputs for all three cases.
Until that gate is satisfied, no private implementation package, source bundle or non-public technical material is part of this step.

questions: Can REQVARIS reproduce all three cases exactly against the same fixed public revision?
Does any execution request appear after a DENY?
Does revocation between detection and consequence-time check reliably prevent execution?
Are the decision and execution-log records sufficient to diagnose any mismatch?

cta.title: Run the 3/3 local reproduction
cta.body: Once the fixed public revision is posted, run the three agreed cases locally without Vision Edge or MITHRIL. Integration starts only after 3/3 pass.
